cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you cut that bridge ribbon, remember who taught you to check a load calculation. Your speech could mention me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It thanks the entire engineering team.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've learned teamwork. Now add the person who caught your missing zero.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll say you checked the calculations. I'm not announcing my mistake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sensible editing; I taught you that too. Use my full name before 'checked the calculations' and we can leave the zero out.

reason: Turn the credit demand into grading a former pupil calculation and speech choices, with B protecting its reputation and A conceding disclosure for a name.
